# Northern-Sky

Northern-Sky is described as a cool, dark-blue aesthetic taken from the northern sky and intended as a calm, focused workspace. Its recorded description names crisp typography, soft contrast and subtle accent hues that keep the interface minimal. The index records the theme under light mode only, which sits oddly beside that dark-blue description.

![Northern-Sky screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quinta0/Northern-Sky/HEAD/Northern-Sky-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Northern-Sky"
    author: "quinta0"
    repo:   "quinta0/Northern-Sky"
    slug:   "northern-sky"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/northern-sky"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/quinta0/Northern-Sky"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/quinta0/Northern-Sky/HEAD/Northern-Sky-small.png"

    modes: ["light"]
    about: "Apply a cool, dark-blue aesthetic inspired by the northern sky to create a calm, focused workspace. Use crisp typography, soft contrast, and subtle accent hues to keep notes readable and the interface minimal."
}
```
